nvitk.cluster.sge_chunk¶

Generic SGE subject-chunk helpers and job-completion polling.

Pipeline-specific logic (e.g. how many jobs one subject produces) belongs in each pipeline package, not here.

Functions¶

chunk_sequence(→ list[list[str]])

Split items into chunks of at most chunk_size (<=0 means one chunk).

warn_if_chunk_exceeds_sge_limit(→ None)

Log a warning if a chunk's total job count (chunk_size × jobs_per_subject) would approach the SGE array-job cap.

parse_sge_submission_job_ids(→ list[str])

Extract SGE job ids from driver-script stdout/stderr (-> 12345 lines).

query_active_sge_job_ids(→ set[str])

Return numeric job ids currently listed for user in qstat.

count_active_sge_jobs(→ int)

Return how many jobs user currently has in qstat.

subjects_fit_in_sge_limit(→ int)

How many whole subjects can be queued without exceeding max_jobs.

subject_fits_in_sge_limit(→ bool)

Return whether jobs_for_subject can be queued given active_job_count.

drip_submit_subjects(→ bool)

Submit subjects when the user's queue has enough free slots.

wait_for_sge_job_ids(→ bool)

Poll qstat via SSH until none of job_ids remain active.

How many whole subjects can be queued without exceeding max_jobs.

margin reserves headroom below the cluster cap so a multi-stage driver script does not fail on its last qsub when the queue is near full.

nvitk.cluster.sge_chunk.drip_submit_subjects(pending_subjects: Sequence[str], submit_subject: collections.abc.Callable[[str], tuple[bool, list[str]]], *, host: str, user: str, password: str, jobs_per_subject: int | collections.abc.Callable[[str], int], poll_interval: float = 120.0, max_jobs: int = 1000, margin: int = 10, loop_timeout: float | None = None, serial: bool = False, wait_timeout: float | None = None, port: int = 22, connect_timeout: float | None = 30.0) → bool¶

Submit subjects when the user’s queue has enough free slots.

submit_subject(subject) -> (ok, job_ids) runs the remote driver for one subject and must return (False, []) on a fatal submission error. Each call queues all jobs for that subject before the next capacity check.

When serial is true, each subject is submitted only after the previous subject’s job_ids have left qstat (one subject in flight at a time).

nvitk.cluster.sge_chunk.wait_for_sge_job_ids(host: str, user: str, password: str, job_ids: Iterable[str], *, poll_interval: float = 120.0, wait_timeout: float | None = None, port: int = 22, connect_timeout: float | None = 30.0) → bool¶

Poll qstat via SSH until none of job_ids remain active.

wait_timeout is wall-clock seconds for the whole wait (None = no limit). Each poll opens a short SSH session; there is no long-lived connection timeout while waiting for jobs to finish.
